title: Understanding World or Predicting Future? A Comprehensive Survey of World Models
author: Jingtao Ding; Yunke Zhang; Yu Shang; Jie Feng; Yuheng Zhang; Zefang Zong; Yuan Yuan; Hongyuan Su; Nian Li; Jinghua Piao; Yucheng Deng; Nicholas Sukiennik; Chen Gao; Fengli Xu; Yong Li
summary: This survey reviews world models that help AI understand and predict the environment. It covers advances in robots, video, and language-based simulations. The goal is to improve AI’s ability to imagine and act in the future.
